title: Getting started
searchTitle: Getting started: data sync and AI setup | Section 11
description: Set up Section 11 in four steps: write an optional dossier, sync your Intervals.icu training data, choose your AI platform and give it the protocol files.

title: Local sync
searchTitle: Local sync setup guide for Intervals.icu data | Section 11
description: Run sync.py on a machine you control to refresh your Intervals.icu training data on a timer for your AI coach to read. No GitHub needed.

title: GitHub sync
searchTitle: GitHub sync setup guide for Intervals.icu data | Section 11
description: Use GitHub Actions to mirror your Intervals.icu training data to a private repository as JSON, on a schedule or on request, for your AI coach to read.

title: On-demand sync
searchTitle: On-demand Intervals.icu sync from your browser | Section 11
description: Run a fresh Intervals.icu sync from your phone or browser, then connect your AI to your repository or download it as a ZIP. No schedule, no local Python.

title: Manual export
searchTitle: Manual JSON export of Intervals.icu data | Section 11
description: Export Intervals.icu training data as JSON for your AI. Setup includes automatic sync by default; use --no-timer to run exports by hand.

title: Report examples
searchTitle: AI coaching report templates and examples | Section 11
description: Templates and annotated examples for Section 11 AI coaching reports: pre-workout, post-workout, 7-day, 28-day and season.

title: Updates and rollback
searchTitle: Section 11 updates, automatic updates and rollback | Section 11
description: Install verified Section 11 releases locally or on GitHub, choose automatic updates, and restore a previous installation when needed.
